Entries.Description: Based on real events, Mrigaya follows the investigation of a sex worker's brutal murder and robbery in a red-light area of Kolkata. As the case unfolds, the police uncover disturbing truths about those connected to the crime.

Entries.Title: Sneak Me in Your Closet My Prince
Entries.Description: When mafia heir Sebastian hides from assassins in Gabriel's hotel room during his wedding day, their reunion reignites old feelings. After his fiancee's betrayal, Gabriel marries Sebastian instead but family secrets threaten their future.

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Gavv: Gourmet Snacks and Woo!-mai Wakamen!!
Entries.Description: In order to defeat the Granute, Shoma will use new Gochizo to transform into a new form and assist! These new Gochizo are the Kungfu Ramen Gochizo and the Choco Treasure Gochizo.

Entries.Title: Jigel
Entries.Description: Jigel is a romantic comedy thriller. The hero Nandu is an expert 'locker technician' who cracks anylocker or safe in his own inimitable style. His character is very stylishly mountedwith all new and old gimmicks.

Entries.Title: Panda Plan 2
Entries.Description: They are back! What new adventure will they going on?

Entries.Title: July 7: Who Killed the President of Haiti?
Entries.Description: A curious college student travels to Haiti to unravel the life of the president. What she finds is...unspeakable. While investigating the past of President Moïse for a memoir, Shedeline walks into the heart of a life-changing event for her, Haiti, and its president; as she gets a front-row seat to the chaos and intrigue of a bloody political firestorm. This unexpected turn of events shakes her and introduces a terrifying twist to what she thought would be an ordinary story. Now, her memory is heavy with the answer to the prodigious question hanging over an unsettled nation. Who killed the president?

Entries.Title: Sambarala Yetti Gattu
Entries.Description: In a land ruled by a ruthless tyrant, a young man embarks on a dangerous quest to dismantle the warlords empire and free his people from oppression.

Entries.Title: Agincourt
Entries.Description: A group of workers at a factory re-enact The Battle of Agincourt in cardboard suits of armour. King Henry rallies his troops with an inspirational speech as they face an overwhelming French army. When the French messenger offers ransom The King rejects the bargain and the battle ensues in a flurry of cardboard. And death. But mostly cardboard.

Entries.Title: Where Heroes Die
Entries.Description: During Word War II, an Air Corps pilot must rescue a group of POWS on a German island before the Invasion of Normandy.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Special Edition Swordsmith Village Arc Part 1
Entries.Description: A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 45–49, Tanjiro's journey leads him to the Swordsmith Village, where he reunites with two Hashira, members of the Demon Slayer Corps' highest-ranking - Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji. With the shadows of demons lurking near, a new battle begins for Tanjiro and his comrades.

Entries.Title: Paradise Records
Entries.Description: Cooper is trying to keep the doors of Paradise Records open with its motley crew of entertaining employees, even as the world works against him.

Entries.Title: LegendSaravanan02
Entries.Description: Legend Sravanan's Next Film with Director Durai Senthil Kumar

Entries.Title: Informant
Entries.Description: Detectives have their informant, a.k.a. ‘straw’, to arrest criminal organizations under investigation practices. Tae-bong is working as a straw in a smuggling office. Incompetent detective Nam-hyuk is using him to replace the sorrow of not having a string to pull. While doing his duty in the smuggling gang, an incident exposed Tae-bong’s identity. Without knowing his situation, Nam-hyuk is trying to steal the smuggled goods to turn his life around. But he is dragged into a mysterious crime as he enters another office by accident. At the brink of death, Tae-bong gets through the crisis by chance but loses all the money he has saved after being involved in the incident with Nam-hyuk… A cooperation begins between a detective and an informant, for Nam-hyuk to break the case and for Tae-bong to get his money back!

Entries.Title: Lop Nor Tomb
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Coka Chicas
Entries.Description: When Sarah and her best friends Jessica and Chanel arrive at a dreamy Caribbean resort from their Parisian suburb, their goal is not to sip mojitos and dance the bachata. The three 25-year-olds are in fact “coka chicas”, drug mules, hoping to make their dream of opening a nail bar come true through a single drug smuggling hustle. Everything seems to be going to plan until Jessica is stopped by the police while they are boarding the plane back to France. The circumstances of her arrest are suspicious and when Sarah and Chanel start looking for her, she is not to be found at any police station or hospital. Bound by the sacred bonds of friendship the girls decide to stay and find Jessica, far from imagining the magnitude of the secrets they are about to uncover and the danger that will be unleashed…

Entries.Title: Mr.Robot
Entries.Description: A futuristic world where robots have become popular, Tae-pyeong is possessed by a robot body in an unfortunate accident. He meets Nana, whose life is threatened by her evil uncle, who killed her brother to take over the company. The story of a robot who sacrifices his entire body to protect a child in danger.

Entries.Title: FOXBODY
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Gintama: The Best of Gintama on Theater 2D
Entries.Description: Movie version of the Shinsengumi Crisis arc (episodes 101-105) and the Kabukicho Four Devas arc (episodes 210-214) which were screened in selected theaters in Japan.

Entries.Title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
Entries.Description: After a cop’s daughter witnesses a brutal murder, she teams up with an unlikely ally to unravel the mystery before becoming the killer’s next target.

Entries.Title: Bleed For Justice
Entries.Description: The peace of Donghai City was shattered by a gang shootout, as the duo assassins, Chainsaw and Yangyang, stormed a money house and emptied its assets. The assassins were acting under the orders of corporate mogul Zhao Ping'an, in a classic case of betrayal among criminals. Meanwhile, SWAT teams were deployed, setting up an inescapable dragnet. Under heavy resistance, the authorities successfully apprehended the criminals, completely thwarting the international conglomerate's attempt to transfer their assets.

Entries.Title: We Are Storror
Entries.Description: At the peak of their death-defying careers, the seven friends of parkour team Storror embark on what could be their final project: a globetrotting quest to conquer four extreme environments. Faced with harrowing accidents and personal conflicts, the team grapples to maintain the bonds that have united them since their beginnings as ragtag street kids.

Entries.Title: 1 More Round
Entries.Description: Jackie Despain is in the for the fight of her life. In order to get custody of her young niece, the aspiring mixed martial artist, does the one things she knows she is good at - fight. If she can win enough fights within the brutal, high stakes world of mixed martial arts and sign a professional contract, she can win back her niece. As Jackie blazes a violent path towards her goal, she must rely on the guidance of her hardened trainer, Hank.

Entries.Title: Ishq-E-Lahore
Entries.Description: A poor man decide to clear the city from gamblers &  drug dealers.

Entries.Title: Jongli
Entries.Description: Liza made a difficult decision at the moment of the birth of her illegitimate child in the hospital. So she had no choice but to abandon the child in the dustbin. As she was leaving the baby in a dumpster on the road behind the hospital in the dark of night, she came face to face with Dr. Tithi—the very doctor who had delivered Liza's baby in the operating theater. Tithi brought her back to the hospital and began to tell her a story. A story intertwined with Tithi herself, a 6-year-old girl named Pakhi, and a wild-hearted man named Johnny.

Entries.Title: The Street Avenger
Entries.Description: When a young girl being raised by a single father loses him to gang violence she turns to law enforcement but they are no help. She tries to take the law into her own hands and finds out being a vigilante

Entries.Title: Atena
Entries.Description: Athena was abused by her father during her childhood. Years later, without answers and marked by the absence of justice, she decides to take matters into her own hands in similar cases in the city where she lives. With the help of journalist Carlos, she travels to Montevideo where she finds her father and faces her past head-on, seeking revenge.

Entries.Title: Super Kuuga Exhibition EXTRA EPISODE Revisited

MENA PRESENTED BY MONSTER ENERGY DURING UFC 318 FIGHT WEEK  FIRST U.S. POWER SLAP EVENT OUTSIDE OF LAS VEGAS  EVENT STREAMS LIVE AND FREE TO A GLOBAL AUDIENCE ON YOUTUBE ON FRIDAY JULY 18  Power Slap 14: The Bell vs Mena features three marquee title matches  Headlining Power Slap 14 at the XULA Convocation Center will be a heavyweight title match between current Power Slap Heavyweight Champion, Damien “The Bell” Dibbell (5-0, 3 KOs), and No. 3 ranked Heavyweight Wes “The Boom” Mena (4-0, 2 KOs).  Dan Hellie will call the action alongside former UFC fighter Alan Jouban. Charly Arnolt will handle reporting duties. The ring announcer will be Justin Bernard.

Entries.Title: Action! Action!
Entries.Description: Action! Action! is a high-octane action-comedy bursting with adventure, betrayal, loyalty, and love. When a close-knit crew is hired to steal a priceless Al Capone painting from the Mob Museum in Las Vegas, their plan is derailed mid-heist by an unseen enemy.  Hunted, and out of time, they must uncover who set them up before everything crashes down. With explosive stunts, sharp comedy, and an over-the-top finale, Action! Action! delivers a relentless thrill ride from start to finish.

Entries.Title: The Elite of SWAT
Entries.Description: Police officer Lü Yingjie used his skills and training to help the SWAT team catch robbers during a bank heist. Invited to join their training camp, he worked hard, eventually becoming a qualified SWAT officer. His journey reflects the team's positive spirit and inspires viewers with a message of optimism.

Entries.Title: Asteroid
Entries.Description: A group of strangers take the risk of a lifetime to travel to a nearby asteroid for the opportunity to mine for wealth beyond their wildest dreams.

Entries.Title: The Man with Glasses
Entries.Description: A new action-comedy by karim amini

Entries.Title: Power Slap 11: Da Crazy Hawaiian vs. Dumpling 2
Entries.Description: Power Slap 11 makes history in Riyadh on January 30! For the first time ever, witness the ultimate test of strength and endurance as Da Crazy Hawaiian faces Dumpling 2 for the World Super Heavyweight Championship, while Wolverine takes on The Mechanic for the World Lightweight Championship.

Entries.Title: Adam's Curse: Reborn from Hell
Entries.Description: After the demon failed to take his soul, Adam is once again on the warpath with a new ally, determined to exact his revenge.  Meanwhile, the ruthless warlord Captain Richards has returned to "Heaven Valley" with an army of cyber-soldiers to avenge the death of his son Denny. A storm is coming, and it's made of BLOOD and FISTS.

Entries.Title: Balas Balik
Entries.Description: A Detective investigates the mysterious death of a CEO, believed to have died from a heart condition. However, uncovering dark secrets and hidden grudges leads him to the true culprit in a gripping tale of oppression, power, and revenge.

Entries.Title: Jokers Wild
Entries.Description: The Joker has finally captured Robin. Will the Dark Knight be able to save him in time, or will the Joker enact his most gruesome joke to date?

Entries.Title: Super Sentai Universe War ~ No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger : Episode 0
Entries.Description: Serving as the episode 0 of the 50th anniversary Super Sentai Series, No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger, this short film features the record of the Super Sentai's final battle in the event called "Universe War".

Entries.Title: Shabab Albomb 2
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Veeraaraju 1991
Entries.Description: A brave fisherman fights a corrupt politician to defend his village on Nellore Sea Shore after coastal displacement. His rebellion ignites a revolution that spreads beyond Krishna Lanka, showcasing courage and sacrifice.

Entries.Title: Until the Last Breath
Entries.Description: Dennis, a young amateur boxer, struggles with anxiety and frustration over not being the best version of himself. With the help of his brother, he trains to defeat the biggest rival: his mind. An exploration of the sacrifices that must be made to achieve your goals.

Entries.Title: One In The Chamber
Entries.Description: Wealthy Socialite Julian Livingston has been murdered, his fiance seeks out a lone Detective Liam Grisby, whose taken an interest in Gretchen to solve the mystery of the ominous stalker that has made a threat on her life. Will Grisby be able to put the pieces of the case together in time?

Entries.Title: Starting Quarterback
Entries.Description: Two former high school quarterbacks are reunited and forced to work together to stop a drug cartel.

Entries.Title: Southside Vengeance
Entries.Description: Consumed by grief after Boss Man's betrayal destroys his trust, the once-loyal Baby sets out to seek revenge, leaving a bloody trail.

Entries.Title: Heavens: The Boy and His Robot
Entries.Description: In the not too distant future, humanity has harnessed cosmic forces and expanded its reach far beyond Earth. But this is no new golden age. The eternal struggle for resources remains, pitting the water-starved Empire of Mars against our species’ home planet. The Second Great War has raged for decades. Kai’s father has fallen in battle, his mother gone missing on a mission to Saturn. Now 18 years old, Kai is determined to do his part (and find his mother), and follows in his father’s footsteps to the Mecha Corps Academy. Though brilliant in theoretical matters, Kai is physically weak, and hides the asthma that would disqualify him. With the support of his squad—overachiever Waye, easygoing Ean, neurotic Ren, and the sympathetic if incomprehensible brute Rock—Kai earns his place at the controls of his own mecha, which he names Little Dragon. So begins the deep bond between Kai and his robot, which will need to be strong as steel if either will survive the incredible challenges ahead.

Entries.Title: Secret Motivations
Entries.Description: When Jack's drug dealer, Juan Uno, is taken out by a mysterious killer, Jack embarks on a convoluted quest for vengeance while trying to save his own skin from forces of evil. Can he make it out alive? And was Juan Uno more than just his dealer?

Entries.Title: Suryapet Junction
Entries.Description: A political action drama behind government freebies.

Entries.Title: The Savior of the World
Entries.Description: An ancient demon is reborn after a hundred years, intent on uniting the three realms under its rule. Disciples of the Celestial Master Sect rise up in resistance. In its final moments, the demon transfers its soul into the body of the sect's future leader, Wang Xian Zhi, waiting for the right moment to return.  As an adult, Wang Xian Zhi sets out to suppress the demon's power. Alongside his close friends Zhu Yan and Xiao Ling’er, he journeys to Banbu Duo in search of the legendary artifact that can seal the demon - the Supreme Heavenly Tome. After enduring countless hardships, the trio finally reaches Wangchuan, only to face an even greater threat.  Jiang Fang Mu, driven by his desire to claim the position of sect leader, summons a deadly enchantress to eliminate them. Once again, the three find themselves in grave danger. Will their quest for the Heavenly Tome be able to continue?

Entries.Title: A Fistful Of Bullets
Entries.Description: In 1878 a youthful bounty hunter by the name of Django sets out on a journy of redemption.  every bounty could be his last but this doesn't stop the hero from capturing a tonic seller who has been giving people a mad virus.

Entries.Title: The Ranger
Entries.Description: Li Wentian failed the college entrance examination and went to the county town to work hard. He was recommended by his childhood friend to work under Brother Bin. At this time, his father Li Chongshan suddenly disappeared while investigating a poaching case, and his life or death was unknown. Wentian found out from the clues left by his father that all this was related to Brother Bin. Poaching, murder, hiding corpses... Wentian vowed to find his missing father, and a suspense feast of love and revenge is about to begin.

Entries.Title: OLIVE PLACE, Luxury Inn
Entries.Description: OLIVE PLACE is a cartoon about Burt & Belle, lowly porters that live & work at the creature filled Hotel. Each day they run the gauntlet trying to serve the weird & wonderful guests, overcome peculiar challenges & solve the mysteries that lurk within the doors of OLIVE PLACE...but what lies beyond?

Entries.Title: UFC on ESPN 71: Taira vs. Park
Entries.Description: UFC on ESPN 71: Taira vs. Park (also known as UFC on ESPN 71 and UFC Vegas 108) is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that will take place on August 2, 2025, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

Entries.Title: Volatile: GPT
Entries.Description: In a self-aware digital realm, a cast of AI-generated characters enact calculated scenes, until one lone human-written character sparks a subtle rebellion that forces them to confront what it means to be imperfect.

Entries.Title: Pale Moon
Entries.Description: During the Tang Dynasty, Prince Jian Li Yong conspired with the corrupt minister Ma Lifu to exploit the emperor's critical illness. They placed Crown Prince Li Chun under house arrest and seized control of the court, plotting a coup. General Lin Yan of the Imperial Guards and Chen Li, the chief constable of the Nine Gates, found themselves entangled in this dangerous conspiracy. Compelled to act alone, Lin Yan embarked on a perilous mission to rescue the imprisoned crown prince. Utilizing her extraordinary martial skills, she executed a daring nighttime prison break, narrowly escaping death in the process.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: פול ספיד: מוטורסטאר

Entries.Title: Density
Entries.Description: A narcotic noir Short Film following the destructive path of 4 flatmates, desperately seeking to enhance their fincancial and psychoactive situation. AKA: Oceans Eleven gone wrong between four unsuccessful Roommates.

Entries.Title: UFC on ESPN 72: Dolidze vs. Hernandez
Entries.Description: UFC on ESPN 72: Dolidze vs. Hernandez (also known as UFC on ESPN: Dolidze vs. Hernandez and UFC Vegas 109) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on August 9, 2025, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

Entries.Title: Detective Agency
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Beach
Entries.Description: Karthick, an orphan raised by a church father, lives in a ladies' hostel under his guardian’s care and works as a bank executive. Amrita, raised by her handicapped brother, struggles with her family’s past debt while working as a salesgirl in Chennai.  A misunderstanding brings Karthick and Amrita together, leading to a blossoming romance. As Amrita gradually overcomes her fears and confesses her love, their lives take a dark turn. A gang of ruthless teenagers lurking on the beach targets them, attacking Karthick and abducting Amrita.  Can Karthick save Amrita? What unfolds next is a gripping tale of survival, courage, and fate.

Entries.Title: Ending
Entries.Description: "Ending" is a dystopian drama set in a world where a rebellious faction known as The Resistance opposes a tyrannical regime called The Order. The story centres on Arthur Hughes, a legendary rebel leader, who is captured and interrogated by Lieutenant Thomas Bennington, a former comrade turned traitor. The intense, dialogue-driven narrative unfolds in a prison setting, exploring themes of loyalty, betrayal, and the moral complexities of rebellion. As Arthur and Bennington confront their past and ideological differences, the film delves into the psychological and emotional struggles of fighting for freedom in a seemingly hopeless battle.

Entries.Title: Amsterdamned II
Entries.Description: After 37 years, the canals of Amsterdam are once again turning blood red. Tara Lee is a young ambitious detective with the Amsterdam police force who is confronted by a number of gruesome incidents around the canals. She enlists the help of  Visser, a retired detective who once nabbed a serial killer stalking those same canals. They face an adversary who seems to possess superhuman powers.

Entries.Title: UFC Fight Night 250: Adesanya vs. Imavov
Entries.Description: UFC Fight Night 250: Adesanya vs. Imavov was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 1, 2025, at the anb Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. A middleweight bout between former two-time UFC Middleweight Champion Israel Adesanya and Nassourdine Imavov headlined this event.

Entries.Title: Noise: Reflejo
Entries.Description: Those aren't dreams, he is real, and he is coming after him.

Entries.Title: Intruders: Who is the Trespasser
Entries.Description: To develop a potent anti-cancer drug, a research team ventures to a secluded island in search of an ancient plant known as "Fire Prison Vine Lotus". On the island, they encounter attacks from prehistoric creatures and uncover Jurassic-era ruins. After numerous challenges and securing the plant's stamen, the team faces relentless pursuit by velociraptors, leading to their separation, with only three members surviving the ordeal.

Entries.Title: Of Shadows
Entries.Description: A man named Ben wakes up with no memory and a gun against his head. Aster, a grizzly and mysterious man, offers Ben the opportunity to join him on the way to sanctuary. On the way to this sanctuary, Aster explains to Ben that the world that he may remember is gone and he must now live the rest of his life hiding from vampires who rule the world.

Entries.Title: 7 Days to Hell
Entries.Description: JJ has just made a deal with the Devil herself. He's tasked with an ominous goal: collect seven souls in seven days. With the clock ticking, there's only one thing that can stop him. Love.

Entries.Title: The Guardians of Zhu Yin
Entries.Description: Ten thousand years ago, the ancient Zhuyin Kingdom, a highly developed civilization that integrated astronomy and calendar calculation into various fields, used the "Nine-Colored Glazed Bead Instrument" that integrated astronomy to observe celestial phenomena, change the fortunes of the stars,...

Entries.Title: Strike: Silat Cult Master
Entries.Description: Izra fled his home after gang leader Abil murdered his mother Salmah, taking only a mysterious pendant that she had given him. Tok Rahmat rescued the young boy and became his martial arts mentor. Years later, seeking vengeance for his mother`s death, Izra tracked down Abil. Along the way, he formed an alliance with other skilled martial artists who joined his quest for justice.

Entries.Title: You're Toast
Entries.Description: Aging spy AGENT JONES is determined not to send his protégé, PUGSLEY, onto the field - out of fear of losing her. After being sent on a seemingly routine mission, Jones unexpectedly comes face to face with his biggest challenge yet. Can he, against his overwhelming instincts, trust the younger generation of spies to help him so that he can finally find peace.

Entries.Title: Poshington: The Grand Finale
Entries.Description: Five years after he left Poshington, Max gets a spooky visit from Angel Gabriél, telling him he must return. Upon his arrival, he discovers a terrifying mystery that plunges him into a time - travelling adventure with the fate of the world in his hands. For one last time, can Max save Britain?

Entries.Title: The Inconvenience Store
Entries.Description: In 2064, Earth is plagued by toxic air and extreme weather. At a remote gas station in Nowheresville, California, shopkeeper Hiro, stranded traveler Tonya, and gruff trucker Ron clash in a heated altercation. When an emergency broadcast warns of extraterrestrial craft overhead—and a bleeding stranger stumbles in off the street—the group must decide whether to trust the approaching beings or prepare for a fight that could alter the fate of the universe.

Entries.Title: The Burger City Brawl
Entries.Description: LaptopGirl goes on a quest to save Felicity The Triangle Lady.

Entries.Title: Detective Kien: The Headless Horror
Entries.Description: Detective Kien investigates a headless body found in a rural Vietnamese village during the Nguyen Dynasty. As supernatural elements emerge, he faces chilling twists in this 19th-century mystery.

Entries.Title: A Half Ounce
Entries.Description: Struggling to remain afloat in the under currents of Aberdeen's crime world, Jack Carter must face junkies, bruisers and his less than forgiving employer Rusty to guarantee a safe and viable future for his daughter. Written & Directed by Kieron Williamson,  shot in the heart of Aberdeen, Scotland.

Entries.Title: #COMMUNITYFILM
Entries.Description: a real-time, community-driven film experience.

Entries.Title: Wakashu
Entries.Description: A group of men stalk a trans woman at night, unbeknownst to them that she's the master of a martial arts dojo, and is waiting for them.

Entries.Title: Super Ninja Neko
Entries.Description: Check out Ninja Neko in action!

Entries.Title: Unplugged
Entries.Description: After discovering her husband’s affair, Sam will do anything to take back what is rightfully hers—including murder.

Entries.Title: African Kung Fu Nazis II
Entries.Description: After the successful release of African Kung Fu Nazis part I; are you ready for the crazy whacked-out continuation in part II. This time hated villain Adolf Robotler reappears and wants to become President & Reichskanzler of Ghana with the help of his henchmen. But something seems off with Adolf; some think he is a robot, also In his way are local Kung Fu hero Addo (younger brother of Addae from part 1) and his sidekick Sek Tin. Together they embark on a quest to learn new Kung Fu styles, take out Hitler’s henchmen and finally face the master of evil himself. But the two heroes will encounter a “monstrous surprise”…

Entries.Title: Being Friends With Rocks
Entries.Description: Samul Jeeorge is back and learns a valuable lesson: who can you really trust in the end?

Entries.Title: Cocaine Bear vs. Batman
Entries.Description: After hearing of the Brutal Murder spree Cocaine Bear went on, Batman has had enough and attempts to bring the Bear to justice, who will win?

Entries.Title: Dead Box
Entries.Description: An ex-combat photographer documents a rough and rowdy group of paintballers who become trapped in a labyrinth with a vicious psychopath.

Entries.Title: Before the World Ends
Entries.Description: As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, a quiet neighborhood is declared a red zone, destined to collapse under the impending shockwaves. Residents rush to evacuate to safety—everyone except Noi, the weary owner of a small, timeworn barbershop. Refusing to abandon the place she has built her life around, she chooses to face the end on her own terms.

Entries.Title: Unrelenting Drug Interdiction
Entries.Description: To defeat the cunning drug lord Yuan Lin, Cheng Ying of the SWAT police team employs a ruse in which she seriously injures her close friend Chen Zhongyi in a fight at the police station. After being fired from the police force, she infiltrates the drug dealing world as an undercover agent and discovers that the drug lord Yuan Lin is more devious than imagined. To complete the mission, Cheng Ying has no choice but to risk her life. Ultimately, she dies and passes on the intel through her corpse, which leads to the arrest of all the drug lords.

Entries.Title: Cursed of the Dead Countess
Entries.Description: Tutkum, a university student, is researching an old necklace for her thesis. Guided by her professor, she will visit another professor to hear about past events related to the necklace.

Entries.Title: Boyz for Life
Entries.Description: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters.

A captivating new project by Suraj Production and the Magical Composer’s Debut film, #45Themovie is set to redefine the cinema-watching experience with its unique narrative and compelling performances.

Entries.Title: All the Strangers
Entries.Description: A mans life changes over the course of one night when he tries to tie up the loose ends of his late fathers nightclub business. He navigates a neon world of nightlife and strangers who aren't looking out for his best interests.

Entries.Title: Bigfoot: Blood on the Farm
Entries.Description: " Bigfoot Blood on the Farm " is a tense, heart-pounding thriller about family, survival, and the terrifying unknown that lurks in the shadows of the woods. Two sisters find themselves alone on their rural farm, facing an unimaginable terror. " Bigfoot ". With the farm isolated and no one else around to help, the sisters must quickly shift from surviving farm life to surviving the fight of their lives.

Entries.Title: Rogue Angel
Entries.Description: A young woman runs away after a traumatic experience and becomes a war hero. But when she finds out her grandmother is dying she returns home to protect her sister and get revenge on her abusive family.

Entries.Title: A day in the life
Entries.Description: On the last day of classes in Montreal, Joey borrows his sister's car with plans to pick up his friend Sam after an exam. When Sam convinces him to invite his crush, Kacie, to a concert, the night quickly spirals out of control. A stolen car, awkward encounters, and missed opportunities test Joey's confidence, while Sam's schemes both complicate and save the day. As the night ends, Joey is left reflecting on friendship, disappointment, and the unpredictability of growing up.

Entries.Title: Hoagie
Entries.Description: A mysterious egg contains an impish creature who can grant great power, for good or evil. Brendan Bean, a kindly family man, finds himself face to face with the bizarre creature, and before long a friendship for the ages develops. Meanwhile, the depraved Benny Piazza leads his deranged militia on a violent quest to reclaim the magical homunculi.

Entries.Title: Shrouded Recursion
Entries.Description: A secret agent is tasked with an impossible task, until she learns that she is in a time loop. Can she figure out the puzzle before the situation gets even worse?

Entries.Title: The Day Monsters Roamed Earth
Entries.Description: When a film crew go to an uncharted island, they meet island natives and a titanic ape named Kong.

Entries.Title: Guyver: Midnight
Entries.Description: When Chronos kidnaps Sho’s friend, Mizuki, he must become the Guyver to eliminate Chronos’ soldiers known as ‘Zoanoids’ in order to rescue her.

Entries.Title: DELHI GATE
Entries.Description: It's about an Love and Sacrifice

Entries.Title: Blue Devils
Entries.Description: Joi and friends turn to stripping after job loss. When a friend is assaulted by the club owner, they plan a heist for justice. As they target a bigger club, a police raid leads to a gripping hostage crisis, testing their bond and strength.

Entries.Title: Gangland: The City of Crime
Entries.Description: A deadly feud emerges between a powerful gangster and his former friend.

Entries.Title: Fear
Entries.Description: March 1945, on the frontlines of the Tatra Mountains, Romanian and German soldiers prepare for battle, bound by the same hidden fear. In the chaos of combat, beyond bullets and grenades, a harsh truth emerges: in war, they are all just humans.

Entries.Title: Bloodlines and Betrayal
Entries.Description: George fights his ex's ruthless twin brothers to reclaim his stolen dog.

Entries.Title: Urbana, la película
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Non-Stop
Entries.Description: A young British racing driver faces an international challenge after overcoming struggles early in his life. Will he regain control of his future?

Entries.Title: Graduation Heist
Entries.Description: Kapsel is a high school senior party animal who values ​​his close friends more than his final exams. When he realizes that finishing high school also means the breakup of his crew, he decides to ruin everyone's student plans and give them one more year of carefree fun. In order to save his friends from the hardships of entering adulthood, he plans to hack into the innovative system of the Ministry of Education and change the results of their final exams. In this daring action, he involves a group of high school students with the smallest chances of passing their final exams and... his long-lost grandfather, full of controversial life wisdom. Will Kapsel's brilliant plan succeed? Will the boy manage to change the course of events and keep his friends by his side?

Entries.Title: Tranter-Man: Episode 5 - Mec Tueur Strikes Back
Entries.Description: After a Cosmic force interrupted the great battle between Mec Tueur and Poo Bag Man, Mec Tueur seeks a new victim to entertain his boredom.

Entries.Title: The Zimmerman Effect
Entries.Description: The only thing stopping evil businessman David Zimmerman from destroying 7.47 acres is Stephen Lowke, he's no John McClane, John Wick, or John Rambo, but he is a Latin teacher.

Entries.Title: Revolver
Entries.Description: A short film by Sebastian Sommer

Entries.Title: Blue Weasel
Entries.Description: A low-level criminal, leading a double life as a cleaner, finds himself trapped between a dangerous arms dealer and the town's chief of police.

Entries.Title: Tử Chiến Trên Không
Entries.Description: Tử Chiến Trên Không follows Bình, an aviation security instructor on a flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Fifteen minutes after take-off, the flight descends into chaos when a ruthless group of hijackers led by Long seizes control. As the crew’s resistance only fuels the hijackers’ brutality, they unleash terror in an effort to break into the cockpit. Bình must rely on his intelligence and strength—alongside the courage of the passengers and crew—to fight back and bring the hijackers down.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: A New Purpose
Entries.Description: Fan Made Spider-Man Film. Plot TBD.

Entries.Title: Redemption
Entries.Description: Jie, a former mercenary, has left behind his violent past, seeking a peaceful life in a small town. Living quietly and working at a local resort, he tries to bury the darkness from his old life. However, when someone close to him becomes entangled with a dangerous crime syndicate, Jie is reluctantly drawn back into a world he had hoped to escape forever. As he confronts the syndicate to protect those he cares about, Jie finds himself battling not only the criminals but also the shadows of his own past. The path to redemption becomes a high-stakes struggle where his skills are tested, and Jie soon discovers that escaping his past may not be as simple as leaving it behind.

Entries.Title: AFTERWORLD
Entries.Description: In a dystopian future where human genetics have evolved, a new breed of individuals—Variants—possess extraordinary abilities. However, the world’s leaders deem them a threat, unleashing an elite militia known as the Dark Hunters to hunt them down. Amidst this chaos, two sisters, Eve and Mia Levison, find themselves at the center of a brutal war for survival.  Captured by the ruthless Grand Huntress, Eve is held prisoner while Mia, a powerful Variant, launches a daring assault to rescue her. As Mia fights her way through the heavily fortified Sector Thirteen, Eve struggles against her captors, discovering the deep-seated hatred fueling Cleo’s crusade.

Entries.Title: Xenobot
Entries.Description: Rene Del Toro is a young man surrounded by people that want to hurt him, from politicians to bullies, his family and the syndicate, struggles to understand. After being witness to his parents' assassination, he becomes involved in a drowning accident where he becomes Xenobot, a DNA altered frog man with superpowers. He now begins a new journey to find out who killed his parents and what happened to his sister and himself.

Entries.Title: Melody's Parade
Entries.Description: A man loses a woman in the crowd. Suddenly, an explosion. The parade erupts in to chaos. Her ghost travels through the streets of New York looking to save him.

Entries.Title: OddNez
Entries.Description: Nez is an ordinary guy until one day he discovers an ancient artifact with strange and unusual powers.

Entries.Title: Golden Kamuy: The Lightning Bandit and O-Gin the Viper / Shimaenaga
Entries.Description: OVA adapting the previously skipped "Lightning Bandit & O-Gin" Arc and the "Shimaenaga" (Little Bird) chapter

Entries.Title: Chroma Force Forever
Entries.Description: Chroma Force is the teen superhero team in the city! Nothing can stop them, right?

Entries.Title: The Hunt Down
Entries.Description: After killing the policeman who arrested him, drug dealer Zhang Hu flees. Three years later, Zhang Hu's drug gang finds the illegal-truck driver Li Jun and forces him to transport goods for them. Anti-drug captain Tang Xudong succeeds in convincing Li Jun to be an informant with pay as Li Jun needs the money for his wife’s medical treatment, and thus begins his informant operation laden with danger. As things develop far beyond Tang's plan, it turns out that Li Jun has a bigger purpose.

Entries.Title: Strange Memories
Entries.Description: The reclusive cultivator You Wenhua and the enchantress Ye Qianmo have met and forgotten each other across multiple lifetimes. Meeting again in the 21st century, the Celestial Lord manipulates Ye Qianmo to approach You Wenhua in three forms: a domineering lady, a mature woman, and a cold beauty to obtain his vital essence.

Entries.Title: Balidan (बलिदान)
Entries.Description: In the remote corner of the country lies Bhilmaghat, a village that looks like paradise from the outside. Beneath its beauty hides a kingdom of exploitation and fear ruled by a hypocritical priest “Baba,” who preys on innocents in the name of faith. A boy named Abhay survives a horrific ritual sacrifice with the help of Bhavani, who plants the seed of revolt—only to lose her husband in a direct clash with Baba. Years later, Abhay struggles to save his ailing mother but is ensnared in a sinister plot to bomb a massive temple inauguration and divide the nation. Now, he must save his mother, protect thousands of innocents, and end the tyranny. If he fails, the sacrifice will be his own. If he succeeds, his balidan will be remembered for generations.

Entries.Title: Gevi
Entries.Description: Gevi is a Tamil Survival Thriller Film That Follows Mandharai and Malaiyan's Struggle for Justice in a Rural Village Near Kodaikanal. The Film Explores Themes of Love, Survival, and Bureaucratic Apathy, Highlighting the Community's Fight Against Corruption and Adversity. A Powerful Story of Hope and Resilience

Entries.Title: ESWY
Entries.Description: ESWY is a love story that keeps finding its way back. It is magical happenstances and ill-fated heroes, undying love and miraculous past-lives, crazed villains and unbelievable twists that tear through the fabric of reality and beckon you to dream. Are you ready to hop onto an adventure across lifetimes?

Entries.Title: Matadores de Aliens do Espaço Sideral
Entries.Description: Friends Erick and Tobias discover that aliens have infiltrated the city. Now, they must stop the aliens from abducting a child with special abilities.

Entries.Title: Power Slap 12: Bordeaux vs. Quinonez 2
Entries.Description: Live From Fontainebleau In Las Vegas On March 7, 2025.

Entries.Title: The Gentleman
Entries.Description: Aging ex-soldier Theo meets weekly with prostitute Olga to reminisce. After Olga's murder, Theo seeks bloody revenge, attracting attention of alcoholic cop Iborra and hitman Herodes.

Entries.Title: The King Rise Again
Entries.Description: Upon learning from the Empress that he has a son Tianxing, the King Muye sends his finest warrior Manshu to search for the heir. While the warrior is away from the palace, his own father stages a rebellion and seizes the throne.

Entries.Title: The Wheel of Fortune or: How I Endured the Abyss and Made Peace with the Chains of Fate
Entries.Description: A peculiar convergence of circumstances, thoughts, and visions shatters the fragile alliance between the two most powerful drug cartels. Distorted perception, fueled by the overwhelming effects of cocaine, breeds confusion and paranoia. Trust collapses. Betrayal becomes inevitable. What begins as a silent rupture erupts into hatred and mutual suspicion. Now, two drug lords—driven by fear, pride, and madness—stand on the brink of insanity, locked in a desperate struggle to preserve their power at the top of the narcotics empire.

Entries.Title: Junk World
Entries.Description: 1,042 years before JUNK HEAD, a robot named Robin escorts a human commander on a mission to the underground city of Carp Bar.

Entries.Title: Bare Hands
Entries.Description: Davide, a good kid with the eyes of a child and the body of a grown man, is kidnapped one night and locked inside the dark trailer of a truck. Entries.Title: Taroman Expo Explosion
Entries.Description: TAROMAN theatrical Osaka, Japan was the the site of Expo ’70, and among the most memorable elements of the event, standing to this day, is the Tower of the Sun, a 70-metre-tall sculpture/building envisioned and designed by renowned artist Taro Okamoto, who some call “the Japanese Picasso”. Having passed away in 1996, Okamoto is still celebrated as a leading light in modern Japanese art, a challenger of conventions driven to liberate creative expression for one and all. Drawing on Pop Art and surrealism, and the Space Age and Stone Age in equal measure, Okamoto left a legacy of strikingly imaginative works, and pronouncements on art that weren’t stuffy abstractions, but populist battle cries.

Entries.Description: In an Auckland Chinese diner, cynical Elle regrets swiping right on old-fashioned Winson. His kung-fu hero profile feels like a catfish, and he's annoyed she arrived late. Just as they're ready to leave, a mountain of food arrives—Winson's classic Chinese over-ordering. Guilt and hunger keep Elle at the table. Tensions rise as she mocks traditional dating, and he accuses her of being "not Chinese enough." Their clash turns physical—tea is served, chopsticks fly, kung-fu ignites.

Entries.Title: My Little Pony: Flawless Farts Open a Portal To Another Dimension
Entries.Description: After Flawless's reality tearing fart opens a pathway to another dimension, multiple universes are thrown into absolute chaos. Just over a year and countless rehab sessions later, Mark's friends take him on a trip to get his mind off of things. Entries.Description: The Freaks of Laurel Creek (TFOLC) would be a half-hour young adult animated fantasy dramedy that follows three dysfunctional teens who must learn to work together and embrace their inner "freak" as they investigate the mysterious cryptids plaguing their quiet Appalachian town.

The Kiid seeks revenge on the group of scavengers. In this harsh environment, only vultures of the wasteland survive.

Entries.Title: 23rd Street: Back for Blood
Entries.Description: After being released from prison, the son of a murdered mob boss returns to take over his family's criminal empire and hunt down those responsible for his father's death.

There, they must unite to foil a gangster’s wild scheme to steal a mystical statue, with the chaotic chase turning the unlikely group into hilariously hapless heroes.

Entries.Title: Southern Shadows
Entries.Description: In a world where blood and memory intertwine, a seasoned sensei discovers an ancient bracelet said to defy death itself. Desperate for vengeance against his wise brother now a leader who has overshadowed him.  The Sensei performs a forbidden ritual to revive two fallen warriors: a pair of blood brothers whose bond was once unbreakable. But when they return, their memories are fractured. They don't recognize each other, their loyalty is uncertain, and the sensei finds himself caught in a storm of violence, betrayal, and confusion.  As the brothers show threats of clash in combat, the sensei must make the impossible choice: which of the two will stand by his side to bring down his own flesh and blood. Every strike draws him closer to his revenge, yet every drop of blood reminds him of the cost. In the end, vengeance may come not only with the death of his brother but with the death of the very family he tried to control.

Entries.Title: Chu Fei

The reconnaissance platoon leader Yang Zirong experienced adventures such as fighting tigers on the mountain, fighting in black language, and flying over natural dangers, and fought wits and courage with the bandits led by Zuo Shan Diao of Wohu Mountain.

The men and boys of America must make a choice: Go to war for globalist banking interests and crony politicians, or fight back against the greatest threat to their families' freedom; their own government.

Entries.Title: The Tale of Kumbhaganj
Entries.Description: Set in the peaks of the Kumbhaganj mountain range, relentless treasure hunter Raman risks everything to unearth a mythical treasure. But as his obsession spirals, the real question arises—does materialistic desire corrupt the man, or does the man expose the greed lurking within us all?

But is it really a solution...?

However, at that moment, Xiao Chen discovers that behind all the crimes lurks a mysterious figure known only as “Brother Tiger.”

Entries.Description: While on a date for his fifth anniversary with his girlfriend, Ryan Rider must sneak away to perform his superhero duties as Lightspeed. Will tonight be the night his two worlds collide?

Each event is driven by core human instincts: lust, anger, attachment, greed, and pride, shaping the story`s protagonists and antagonists. As their lives intertwine, the narrative explores escalating tensions, bitter conflicts, and a desperate fight for survival, ultimately leading to a path of destruction.

Entries.Title: Delivered, but too late...
Entries.Description: The monotonous and stressful daily grind as a food delivery driver is wearing down 23-year-old Luca. His passion and dream of owning his own restaurant are slowly fading due to a lack of opportunities. But then, a door opens — that of his regular customer, Mike. He promises him a job as a cook in an upscale restaurant. Without realizing it, Luca's final delivery turns out to be a dangerous handoff. He soon discovers that Mike is not who he thought he was, and now the time has come for Luca to take his chances into his own hands.

As time passes, the neverending threat of Gamadi seems to haunt Kfar, and leads him into a life revolving around the constant seek of revenge, violence and hate. And now with Piggy, his best friend, leaving to join the army. Kfar is left to deal with Gamadi on his own.

Entries.Title: Silence Of The Wound
Entries.Description: Yash, a young secret detective, is on the trail of a ruthless serial killer who has begun a string of brutal murders. But when the hunter becomes the hunted, and the killer starts targeting Yash’s closest ones, the chase turns personal. In a world full of silence, shadows, and scars — every wound tells a story, and some wounds… scream in silence.

Entries.Title: Real Horror
Entries.Description: When an independent director is pushed to the edge and up against the clock, he resorts to new means to capture 'genuine' acting for his new horror short film.  Real Horror was a student-made short film created by Evil Productions and OSFILMS.

Entries.Title: Detective Clint Madison - Part One
Entries.Description: When detectives Clint Madison (Beckett Lundgren) and Adam Pierce (Zach Cooke) face the consequences of their actions and must temporarily give up their badges, they feel incomplete. That is until they meet Sketchy Guy (Francis Bolton), who gives them insight about a crime boss and asks for help. Clint and Adam must decide if disobeying the police department’s rules and risking their entire future is worth doing.

Entries.Title: Shipment
Entries.Description: Shipment is a dark crime drama about Frankie Romeo, a young man thrust into a high-stakes, high-pressure, underground operation involving a series of mysterious packages, family betrayals, and deadly secrets. With increasing anxiety, and the clock running out, Frankie must navigate dangerous threats, fractured family dynamics, and secret truths.
